def max_product_increasing_subsequence(arr):
    if not arr:
        return 0
    
    n = len(arr)
    # dp[i] will store the maximum product of an increasing subsequence ending at index i
    dp = [x for x in arr] 
    
    for i in range(n):
        current_val = arr[i]
        max_prod_so_far = current_val
        
        # Check all previous elements to see if they can extend a sequence
        for j in range(i):
            if arr[j] < current_val:  # Strictly increasing condition
                prod = dp[j] * current_val
                if prod > max_prod_so_far:
                    max_prod_so_far = prod
        
        dp[i] = max_prod_so_far
    
    return max(dp)
